general_information.Description: Upon completion of this course students shoud: 1. Understand the followings: • ReactJS concepts for building Front-End application • RESTful API concepts • RESTful API using Spring Boot's built-in features and frameworks • Security features (authentication and authorization) with RESTful API • Handling HTTP requests and responses using Spring Boot's framework • Error handling and exception management in Spring Boot RESTful APIs 2. Be able to: • Build RESTful APIs using Spring Boot's built-in features and frameworks • Implement security features with authentication and authorization • Handle HTTP requests and responses using Spring Boot's framework • Build Front-End application using ReactJS components • Integrate Spring Boot with other technologies and frameworks SQL Server, MongoDB, and ReactJS 3. Be able to work in team and present group's results
general_information.StudentTasks: - Students must attend at least 80% of contact sessions in order to be accepted to the final examination. - Student is responsible to do all assigned exercises given by instructor in class or at home and submit on time - Use laptop in class only for learning purpose - Promptly access to the FU CMS at http://flm.fpt.edu.vn for up-to-date course information
general_information.Tools: - Internet - IntelliJ IDEA - JDK 21 - Platform: SpringBoot 3, Node 21

learning_outcomes.CLO Details: Understand of the ReactJS library, services, and dependency injection.
Apply fetch and catching data in Client-Server Communication
Describe RESTful APIs using Spring Boot's built-in features and frameworks
Describe the connecting RESTful Web Service with JPA
Apply security features such as authentication and authorization
Create application with Hibernate and Spring Framework.
Apply Spring Data with MongoDB to build an application.
Develop teamwork skills, communication skills (including presentation skills)

assessments.Question Type: Multiple choices Marked by Computer or a suitable format

assessments.CLO: CLO1, CLO2, CLO3, CLO4, CLO5, CLO6, CLO7,CLO8
assessments.Note: Each part of the final exam must be >=4/10 & Final Result >=5/10.
